name: salon-software
description: Dev meta-repo. Client/ deploys to Vercel (frontend repo), Server/ deploys to Render (backend repo). Each is an independent package; there are no npm workspaces.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Client && npm install --prefix Server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix Client && npm run typecheck --prefix Server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix Server && npm test --prefix Client
